Accumulator Boost

Up to 25% extra

Rules & terms

  1. Place a cash accumulator with at least four football selections at odds of 1.40 or higher each.
  2. Four winning legs earn 5% extra on net winnings. Add five percentage points per additional winning leg, up to 25%.
  3. Void legs are removed before calculating the boost. The maximum boost is ₦20,000 per ticket.

18+ and verified accounts only. Unless stated otherwise, cash-outs, void bets and bonus stakes do not qualify. Free-bet stakes are excluded from returns.
